suite_command: node --test --test-reporter=spec   (cwd: the worktree copy; the widest command the run itself ran, nav-717d... verify1)

notes.copy: the worktree was copied to scratch; its .git worktree pointer file was replaced by a fresh git repo in the copy so that diff/checkout/clean never touch the original's git metadata
notes.survivor_reruns: a variant whose first suite run passed was rerun four more times (the HTTP tests use a random board); survived = 5 of 5 passes
notes.claims_checked: claimed_by was read from the test-spec results (nav-5cbd..., nav-72d5..., nav-9284... test_cases), the final test/rules.test.js and test/server.test.js, and the step-plan criteria (nav-e1b3..., nav-a4ed...) in run_dir/results
notes.stability_rule: stability.jsonl: a variant whose first run failed only in the shared-port tests (TC-2), or whose kill depends on the random board, was rerun 12 to 60 times; killed means a genuine failure in at least half of the runs; kill_fraction is recorded; a failure of only 'R-2 (TC-2) port' or 'TC-2 (a)' on a non-port variant is port contention with other workers (shared ports 3000 and 3456), counted as noise_only_failures
notes.replay: WORK=<copy> node witnesses/<id>.js (exit 0 holds, 1 violated, 3 witness error); apply patches/<id>.patch to a copy of the worktree made as in notes.copy, then run node --test --test-reporter=spec in it
notes.natural_gap: R-4.6 is checked with POST (the spec's confirm line). On the unchanged copy PUT, DELETE and PATCH /api/new return 404, not the 405 the sentence 'A non-GET method returns 405' states; this is a gap of the product itself and no variant was needed to find it
